These fixtures are synthetic. They follow the response shapes in the Meraki
Dashboard API v1 reference, but every ID, name, and value is made up.

They were written by hand because the published DevNet always-on sandbox keys
returned 401 on 2026-11-16 (see LOG.md). Replace them with real responses by
running `uv run python -m netops_agent.record tests/fixtures` once a working
MERAKI_API_KEY is available.

File name = request path with "/" replaced by "_", plus "_<productType>" for
event queries.
